_about: One plain sentence per layer, shown to the model with the data briefing. Data from OpenStreetMap (c) OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL. Downloaded with scripts/download_osm_data.py for the Sharjah city area.
sharjah_hospitals: Hospitals AND clinics in the Sharjah area. The field 'type' is 'hospital' or 'clinic'; filter on it when the person means only one kind.
sharjah_districts: Named districts and neighbourhoods as POINTS (one point per district, no boundaries). For anything per district or per area, first make areas with service_areas("sharjah_districts"). To find which district a place is in, use nearest(place, "sharjah_districts").
sharjah_parks: Public parks in the Sharjah area, with their outlines (polygons).
sharjah_main_roads: Main roads (motorway, trunk, primary) in the Sharjah area; one feature per named road. The field 'type' is the road class.
